verses.original: וְֽאוּלָ֗ם שְׁמַֽע־ נָ֣א אִיּ֣וֹב מִלָּ֑י וְֽכָל־ דְּבָרַ֥י הַאֲזִֽינָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ū·lām šə·ma‘- nā ’î·yō·wḇ mil·lāy wə·ḵāl də·ḇā·ray ha·’ă·zî·nāh
verses.literal: But now O Job hear my speech and listen to all my words
verses.literalPt: ASSIM, na verdade, ó Jó, ouve as minhas razões, e dá ouvidos a todas as minhas palavras.

verses.original: הִנֵּה־ נָ֭א פָּתַ֣חְתִּי פִ֑י דִּבְּרָ֖ה לְשׁוֹנִ֣י בְחִכִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh- nā pā·ṯaḥ·tî p̄î dib·bə·rāh lə·šō·w·nî ḇə·ḥik·kî
verses.literal: Behold . . . I will open my mouth my address is on the tip of my tongue
verses.literalPt: Eis que já abri a minha boca; já falou a minha língua debaixo do meu paladar.

verses.original: יֹֽשֶׁר־ לִבִּ֥י אֲמָרָ֑י וְדַ֥עַת שְׂ֝פָתַ֗י בָּר֥וּר מִלֵּֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: yō·šer- lib·bî ’ă·mā·rāy wə·ḏa·‘aṯ śə·p̲ā·t̲ai bā·rūr mil·lê·lū
verses.literal: My words are from an upright heart and my lips speak sincerely what I know
verses.literalPt: As minhas razões provam a sinceridade do meu coração, e os meus lábios proferem o puro saber.

verses.original: רֽוּחַ־ אֵ֥ל עָשָׂ֑תְנִי וְנִשְׁמַ֖ת שַׁדַּ֣י תְּחַיֵּֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: rū·aḥ- ’êl ‘ā·śā·ṯə·nî wə·niš·maṯ šad·day tə·ḥay·yê·nî
verses.literal: The Spirit of God has made me and the breath of the Almighty gives me life
verses.literalPt: O Espírito de Deus me fez; e a inspiração do Todo-Poderoso me deu vida.

verses.original: אִם־ תּוּכַ֥ל הֲשִׁיבֵ֑נִי עֶרְכָ֥ה לְ֝פָנַ֗י הִתְיַצָּֽבָה׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- tū·ḵal hă·šî·ḇê·nî ‘er·ḵāh lə·p̄ā·nay hiṯ·yaṣ·ṣā·ḇāh
verses.literal: Refute me if you can prepare your case and confront me . . .
verses.literalPt: Se podes, responde-me, põe em ordem as tuas razões diante de mim, e apresenta-te.

verses.original: הֵן־ אֲנִ֣י כְפִ֣יךָ לָאֵ֑ל מֵ֝חֹ֗מֶר קֹרַ֥צְתִּי גַם־ אָֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: hên- ’ă·nî ḵə·p̄î·ḵā lā·’êl mê·ḥō·mer qō·raṣ·tî ḡam- ’ā·nî
verses.literal: I . . . am just like you before God I was also formed from clay
verses.literalPt: Eis que vim de Deus, como tu; do barro também eu fui formado.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה אֵ֭מָתִי לֹ֣א תְבַעֲתֶ֑ךָּ וְ֝אַכְפִּ֗י עָלֶ֥יךָ לֹא־ יִכְבָּֽד׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ’ê·mā·ṯî lō ṯə·ḇa·‘ă·ṯe·kā wə·’aḵ·pî ‘ā·le·ḵā lō- yiḵ·bāḏ
verses.literal: Surely no fear of me should terrify you nor will my hand be heavy upon you
verses.literalPt: Eis que não te perturbará o meu terror, nem será pesada sobre ti a minha mão.

verses.original: אַ֭ךְ אָמַ֣רְתָּ בְאָזְנָ֑י וְק֖וֹל מִלִּ֣ין אֶשְׁמָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ ’ā·mar·tā ḇə·’ā·zə·nāy wə·qō·wl mil·lîn ’eš·mā‘
verses.literal: Surely you have spoken in my hearing . . . and I have heard these very words
verses.literalPt: Na verdade tu falaste aos meus ouvidos; e eu ouvi a voz das tuas palavras. Dizias:

verses.original: זַ֥ךְ אֲנִ֗י בְּֽלִ֫י פָ֥שַׁע חַ֥ף אָנֹכִ֑י וְלֹ֖א עָוֺ֣ן לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: zaḵ ’ă·nî bə·lî p̄ā·ša‘ ḥap̄ ’ā·nō·ḵî wə·lō ‘ā·wōn lî
verses.literal: I am pure without transgression I am clean with no iniquity in me
verses.literalPt: Limpo estou, sem transgressão; puro sou, e não tenho iniqüidade.

verses.original: הֵ֣ן תְּ֭נוּאוֹת עָלַ֣י יִמְצָ֑א יַחְשְׁבֵ֖נִי לְאוֹיֵ֣ב לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hên tə·nū·’ō·wṯ ‘ā·lay yim·ṣā yaḥ·šə·ḇê·nî lə·’ō·w·yêḇ lōw
verses.literal: Yet God finds occasions against me He counts me as His enemy
verses.literalPt: Eis que procura pretexto contra mim, e me considera como seu inimigo.

verses.original: יָשֵׂ֣ם בַּסַּ֣ד רַגְלָ֑י יִ֝שְׁמֹ֗ר כָּל־ אָרְחֹתָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: yā·śêm bas·saḏ raḡ·lāy yiš·mōr kāl- ’ā·rə·ḥō·ṯāy
verses.literal: He puts my feet in the stocks He watches over all my paths
verses.literalPt: Põe no tronco os meus pés, e observa todas as minhas veredas.

verses.original: הֶן־ זֹ֣את לֹא־ צָדַ֣קְתָּ אֶעֱנֶ֑ךָּ כִּֽי־ יִרְבֶּ֥ה אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַ מֵאֱנֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: hen- zōṯ lō- ṣā·ḏaq·tā ’e·‘ĕ·ne·kā kî- yir·beh ’ĕ·lō·w·ha mê·’ĕ·nō·wōš
verses.literal: Behold you are not right in this matter I will answer you for God is greater than man
verses.literalPt: Eis que nisso não tens razão; eu te respondo; porque maior é Deus do que o homem.

verses.original: מַ֭דּוּעַ אֵלָ֣יו רִיב֑וֹתָ כִּ֥י כָל־ דְּ֝בָרָ֗יו לֹ֣א־ יַעֲנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mad·dū·a‘ ’ê·lāw rî·ḇō·w·ṯā kî ḵāl də·ḇā·rāw lō- ya·‘ă·neh
verses.literal: Why do you complain to Him that He answers nothing . . . a man asks
verses.literalPt: Por que razão contendes com ele, sendo que não responde acerca de todos os seus feitos?

verses.original: כִּֽי־ בְאַחַ֥ת יְדַבֶּר־ אֵ֑ל וּ֝בִשְׁתַּ֗יִם לֹ֣א יְשׁוּרֶֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḇə·’a·ḥaṯ yə·ḏab·ber- ’êl ū·ḇiš·ta·yim lō yə·šū·ren·nāh
verses.literal: For God speaks in one way and in another yet no one notices
verses.literalPt: Antes Deus fala uma e duas vezes; porém ninguém atenta para isso.

verses.original: בַּחֲל֤וֹם׀ חֶזְי֬וֹן לַ֗יְלָה בִּנְפֹ֣ל תַּ֭רְדֵּמָה עַל־ אֲנָשִׁ֑ים בִּ֝תְנוּמ֗וֹת עֲלֵ֣י מִשְׁכָּֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ba·ḥă·lō·wm ḥez·yō·wn lay·lāh bin·p̄ōl tar·dê·māh ‘al- ’ă·nā·šîm biṯ·nū·mō·wṯ ‘ă·lê miš·kāḇ
verses.literal: In a dream in a vision in the night when deep sleep falls upon men as they slumber on their beds
verses.literalPt: Em sonho ou em visão noturna, quando cai sono profundo sobre os homens, e adormecem na cama.

verses.original: אָ֣ז יִ֭גְלֶה אֹ֣זֶן אֲנָשִׁ֑ים וּבְמֹ֖סָרָ֣ם יַחְתֹּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’āz yiḡ·leh ’ō·zen ’ă·nā·šîm ū·ḇə·mō·sā·rām yaḥ·tōm
verses.literal: He opens their ears . . . and terrifies them with warnings
verses.literalPt: Então o revela ao ouvido dos homens, e lhes sela a sua instrução,

verses.original: לְ֭הָסִיר אָדָ֣ם מַעֲשֶׂ֑ה וְגֵוָ֖ה מִגֶּ֣בֶר יְכַסֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lə·hā·sîr ’ā·ḏām ma·‘ă·śeh wə·ḡê·wāh mig·ge·ḇer yə·ḵas·seh
verses.literal: to turn a man from wrongdoing and keep him from pride
verses.literalPt: Para apartar o homem daquilo que faz, e esconder do homem a soberba.

verses.original: יַחְשֹׂ֣ךְ נַ֭פְשׁוֹ מִנִּי־ שָׁ֑חַת וְ֝חַיָּת֗וֹ מֵעֲבֹ֥ר בַּשָּֽׁלַח׃
verses.transliteration: yaḥ·śōḵ nap̄·šōw min·nî- šā·ḥaṯ wə·ḥay·yā·ṯōw mê·‘ă·ḇōr baš·šā·laḥ
verses.literal: to preserve his soul from the Pit and his life from perishing by the sword
verses.literalPt: Para desviar a sua alma da cova, e a sua vida de passar pela espada.

verses.original: וְהוּכַ֣ח בְּ֭מַכְאוֹב עַל־ מִשְׁכָּב֑וֹ וְרִיב עֲצָמָ֣יו אֵתָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hū·ḵaḥ bə·maḵ·’ō·wḇ ‘al- miš·kā·ḇōw wə·rīḇ ‘ă·ṣā·māw ’ê·ṯān
verses.literal: A man is also chastened on his bed with pain and constant distress in his bones
verses.literalPt: Também na sua cama é castigado com dores; e com incessante contenda nos seus ossos;

verses.original: וְזִֽהֲמַ֣תּוּ חַיָּת֣וֹ לָ֑חֶם וְ֝נַפְשׁ֗וֹ מַאֲכַ֥ל תַּאֲוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·zi·hă·mat·tū ḥay·yā·ṯōw lā·ḥem wə·nap̄·šōw ma·’ă·ḵal ta·’ă·wāh
verses.literal: so that he detests his bread and his soul loathes his favorite food
verses.literalPt: De modo que a sua vida abomina até o pão, e a sua alma a comida apetecível.

verses.original: יִ֣כֶל בְּשָׂר֣וֹ מֵרֹ֑אִי וּשְׁפִי עַ֝צְמוֹתָ֗יו לֹ֣א רֻאּֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: yi·ḵel bə·śā·rōw mê·rō·’î ū·šə·p̄ī ‘aṣ·mō·w·ṯāw lō ru’·’ū
verses.literal: His flesh wastes away from sight and his hidden . . . bones protrude
verses.literalPt: Desaparece a sua carne a olhos vistos, e os seus ossos, que não se viam, agora aparecem.

verses.original: וַתִּקְרַ֣ב לַשַּׁ֣חַת נַפְשׁ֑וֹ וְ֝חַיָּת֗וֹ לַֽמְמִתִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiq·raḇ laš·ša·ḥaṯ nap̄·šōw wə·ḥay·yā·ṯōw lam·mi·ṯîm
verses.literal: He draws near to the Pit and his life to the messengers of death
verses.literalPt: E a sua alma se vai chegando à cova, e a sua vida aos que trazem a morte.

verses.original: אִם־ יֵ֤שׁ עָלָ֨יו׀ מַלְאָ֗ךְ מֵלִ֗יץ אֶחָ֥ד מִנִּי־ אָ֑לֶף לְהַגִּ֖יד לְאָדָ֣ם יָשְׁרֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- yêš ‘ā·lāw mal·’āḵ mê·lîṣ ’e·ḥāḏ min·nî- ’ā·lep̄ lə·hag·gîḏ lə·’ā·ḏām yā·šə·rōw
verses.literal: Yet if there is a messenger on his side one mediator in a thousand to tell a man what is right for him
verses.literalPt: Se com ele, pois, houver um mensageiro, um intérprete, um entre milhares, para declarar ao homem a sua retidão,

verses.original: וַיְחֻנֶּ֗נּוּ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר פְּ֭דָעֵהוּ מֵרֶ֥דֶת שָׁ֗חַת מָצָ֥אתִי כֹֽפֶר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḥun·nen·nū way·yō·mer pə·ḏā·‘ê·hū mê·re·ḏeṯ šā·ḥaṯ mā·ṣā·ṯî ḵō·p̄er
verses.literal: to be gracious to him and say Spare him from going down to the Pit I have found his ransom
verses.literalPt: Então terá misericórdia dele, e lhe dirá: Livra-o, para que não desça à cova; já achei resgate.

verses.original: רֻֽטֲפַ֣שׁ בְּשָׂר֣וֹ מִנֹּ֑עַר יָ֝שׁ֗וּב לִימֵ֥י עֲלוּמָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ru·ṭă·p̄aš bə·śā·rōw min·nō·‘ar yā·šūḇ lî·mê ‘ă·lū·māw
verses.literal: then his flesh is refreshed like a child’s he returns to the days of his youth
verses.literalPt: Sua carne se reverdecerá mais do que era na mocidade, e tornará aos dias da sua juventude.

verses.original: יֶעְתַּ֤ר אֶל־ אֱל֨וֹהַּ׀ וַיִּרְצֵ֗הוּ וַיַּ֣רְא פָּ֭נָיו בִּתְרוּעָ֑ה וַיָּ֥שֶׁב לֶ֝אֱנ֗וֹשׁ צִדְקָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ye‘·tar ’el- ’ĕ·lō·w·ah way·yir·ṣê·hū way·yar pā·nāw biṯ·rū·‘āh way·yā·šeḇ le·’ĕ·nō·wōš ṣiḏ·qā·ṯōw
verses.literal: He prays to God and finds favor he sees God’s face and shouts for joy and God restores His righteousness to that man
verses.literalPt: Deveras orará a Deus, o qual se agradará dele, e verá a sua face com júbilo, e restituirá ao homem a sua justiça.

verses.original: יָשֹׁ֤ר׀ עַל־ אֲנָשִׁ֗ים וַיֹּ֗אמֶר חָ֭טָאתִי וְיָשָׁ֥ר הֶעֱוֵ֗יתִי וְלֹא־ שָׁ֥וָה לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: yā·šōr ‘al- ’ă·nā·šîm way·yō·mer ḥā·ṭā·ṯî wə·yā·šār he·‘ĕ·wê·ṯî wə·lō- šā·wāh lî
verses.literal: Then he sings before men with these words I have sinned and perverted what was right yet I did not get what I deserved
verses.literalPt: Olhará para os homens, e dirá: Pequei, e perverti o direito, o que de nada me aproveitou.

verses.original: פָּדָ֣ה נַפְשִׁי מֵעֲבֹ֣ר בַּשָּׁ֑חַת וְחַיָּתִי בָּא֥וֹר תִּרְאֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: pā·ḏāh nap̄·šī mê·‘ă·ḇōr baš·šā·ḥaṯ wə·ḥay·yå̄·ṯī bā·’ō·wr tir·’eh
verses.literal: He redeemed my soul from going down to the Pit and I will live to see the light
verses.literalPt: Porém Deus livrou a minha alma de ir para a cova, e a minha vida verá a luz.

verses.original: הֶן־ כָּל־ אֵ֭לֶּה יִפְעַל־ אֵ֑ל פַּעֲמַ֖יִם שָׁל֣וֹשׁ עִם־ גָּֽבֶר׃
verses.transliteration: hen- kāl- ’êl·leh yip̄·‘al- ’êl pa·‘ă·ma·yim šā·lō·wōš ‘im- gā·ḇer
verses.literal: Behold all these things God does to a man two or even three times
verses.literalPt: Eis que tudo isto é obra de Deus, duas e três vezes para com o homem,

verses.original: לְהָשִׁ֣יב נַ֭פְשׁוֹ מִנִּי־ שָׁ֑חַת לֵ֝א֗וֹר בְּא֣וֹר הַֽחַיִּים׃
verses.transliteration: lə·hā·šîḇ nap̄·šōw min·nî- šā·ḥaṯ lê·’ō·wr bə·’ō·wr ha·ḥay·yîm
verses.literal: to bring back his soul from the Pit that he may be enlightened with the light of life
verses.literalPt: Para desviar a sua alma da perdição, e o iluminar com a luz dos viventes.

verses.original: הַקְשֵׁ֖ב אִיּ֥וֹב שְֽׁמַֽע־ לִ֑י הַ֝חֲרֵ֗שׁ וְאָנֹכִ֥י אֲדַבֵּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: haq·šêḇ ’î·yō·wḇ šə·ma‘- lî ha·ḥă·rêš wə·’ā·nō·ḵî ’ă·ḏab·bêr
verses.literal: Pay attention Job and listen to me be silent and I will speak
verses.literalPt: Escuta, pois, ó Jó, ouve-me; cala-te, e eu falarei.

verses.original: אִם־ יֵשׁ־ מִלִּ֥ין הֲשִׁיבֵ֑נִי דַּ֝בֵּ֗ר כִּֽי־ חָפַ֥צְתִּי צַדְּקֶֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- yêš- mil·lîn hă·šî·ḇê·nî dab·bêr kî- ḥā·p̄aṣ·tî ṣad·də·qe·kā
verses.literal: But if you have something to say answer me speak up for I would like to vindicate you
verses.literalPt: Se tens alguma coisa que dizer, responde-me; fala, porque desejo justificar-te.

verses.original: אִם־ אַ֭יִן אַתָּ֥ה שְֽׁמַֽע־ לִ֑י הַ֝חֲרֵ֗שׁ וַאֲאַלֶּפְךָ֥ חָכְמָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’im- ’a·yin ’at·tāh šə·ma‘- lî ha·ḥă·rêš wa·’ă·’al·lep̄·ḵā ḥāḵ·māh
verses.literal: But if not . . . then listen to me be quiet and I will teach you wisdom
verses.literalPt: Se não, escuta-me tu; cala-te, e ensinar-te-ei a sabedoria.
